source: Banco Central do Brasil, SGS (Sistema Gerenciador de Séries Temporais) API; IPCA and GDP originate at IBGE
notes: Realized values for 1999 to 2025. 2026 and later are excluded (not yet realized). SGS 13522: IPCA accumulated over 12 months, December value. SGS 3696 and 3697: USD/BRL PTAX sell rate, December end of period and December average. No errors or grades are computed.
